equipment_type: Multi-brand VRF / split AC BACnet gateway
applies_to: Indoor units of VRF and split systems connected to a CoolMasterNet or CooLink gateway (Daikin, Mitsubishi Electric, LG, Samsung, Gree and other supported brands).
summary: CoolMasterNet and the CooLink family connect to the AC manufacturer's indoor-unit bus and serve every indoor unit as the same 16 BACnet objects, over BACnet MS/TP and/or BACnet IP. Instance numbers are built from the unit's virtual address (VA): instance = VA x 256 + object index. Configuration is done with text commands on the gateway's ASCII interface.
notes: Points shown for virtual address VA 1 (instances 256-258); add 256 for each further VA.
The object identifier's instance field is VA in bits 21-8 and object index in bits 7-0.
Access follows the guide's object-type table: BV, AV, MV and PIV read/write; BI, AI and CSV read-only.
Object names are not printed in the guide; the object descriptions are used as names.
Fan speed, mode and louver states that a given unit does not support are simply not used.
Operation Mode state 8 is not printed in the guide.

source.title: BACnet Integration Guidelines - CoolMasterNet, CooLinkNet, CooLinkHub, CooLinkBridge

integration.summary: Enable BACnet MS/TP on line L3 and/or BACnet IP, run 'va auto' so each indoor unit gets a virtual address, then map each unit's block of objects at VA x 256. Command BV ON/OFF, MV Operation Mode, AV Set Temperature and MV Fan Speed, and read AI Room Temperature and BI HVAC Failure Indication.

minimum_points.name: Global Lock (prohibit)
minimum_points.why: Lock out the wired remote if the BMS is in charge

integration.enable: BACnet must be enabled on the gateway ('line type L3 BAC' for MS/TP, 'bacnet IP enable' for IP); no BMS enable object is documented.
setup: BACnet MS/TP: activate on line L3 with 'line type L3 BAC' (L4-L7 also possible on CoolMasterNet); default frame 9600 8N1, change with 'line baud L3 <rate>_8N1'; MAC (TS) default 0x40 = 64, change with 'line myid L3 <hex>'. Reboot after each change.
BACnet IP: enable with 'bacnet IP enable'; UDP port 47808 by default ('bacnet port <n>'). The server starts only once Ethernet is up with an IP address.
Default device instance 64 (0x40); change with 'bacnet instance <n>'.
Allocate virtual addresses with 'va auto' (one VA per detected indoor unit) or 'va + L1.102 0004'; list them with 'va'.
One MS/TP and one BACnet IP connection can run at the same time.
gotchas: Running 'va auto' again deletes and re-allocates all VAs, which renumbers every object; only run it once all indoor units are connected.
Every configuration command needs a reboot to take effect.
Additional MS/TP connections are not supported even if more RS-485 lines exist.
The guide's MS/TP example output shows TS 64 and device instance 64 by default; set unique values for each gateway.
